visual_description: A 22-second continuous excerpt of a SUMO road-network screen recording. The top-down view shows multilane roads, turning connections, and several linked intersections on a white background. Small vehicle symbols travel along lanes, form queues on approaches, and pass through intersections. The recorded view pans and zooms between junctions, including closer views of traffic at two four-way intersections, then moves along connecting roads. The SUMO toolbar, simulation clock, status area, and desktop taskbar remain visible because the complete source frame is retained. The title bar identifies colorado_medium.sumocfg. The excerpt runs from 00:24 to 00:46 of the supplied TL_medium.mp4 file at the original recording speed. The source recording has a silent audio track, which is removed from this web version. The displayed recording speed should not be interpreted as real-world vehicle speed. The filename suggests traffic-light control; the clip alone does not verify the controller, robot-vehicle share, U/S configuration, or quantitative performance. This is a simulation recording, not evidence of the learned controller operating on public roads.
